title: Parameter - JSON
description: Inserts the parameter inside a JSON object. Returns an HTML content type. Note that this allows browsers to execute scripts.
php:
Parameter - JSON in HTML Response

The q parameter is reflected directly inside a raw JSON string served with an text/html content-type.

Param: ?q=

⬇️ Output:

{"status": "ok", "query": ""}
objectives: Inject HTML tags into the JSON output rendered in an HTML document.
Understand why serving JSON with text/html content-type leads to XSS.
hints: The content type is HTML, so any HTML tags will be parsed by the browser.
